Inside there's... one big door key, a blue plan, and postcards.

So behind those old books, there's a ninth door!

meanings.note: Pinyin: yī. Changes tone to yí before 4th tone (一个 yí gè) and yì before 1st/2nd/3rd tones (一杯 yì bēi).

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yí yàng. Pairs with 跟/和 in 跟…一样 ('the same as…').

examples.text: 等等，深蓝色的，跟您的一样啊！
examples.trans: Wait—it is dark blue, the same as yours!

examples.text: 哎呀！我跑得太急，包装看着都一样！
examples.trans: Oh no! I was running in such a rush that the wrappers all looked alike!

meanings.note: Pinyin: shàng. Used both as a directional verb/complement ('up, onto') and location word ('on top of').

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bù. Standard negation for present/future/habitual verbs and adjectives; shifts to bú before a 4th tone (不是 bú shì).

examples.text: 下雨的时候，纸不会弄丢房间名单。
examples.trans: When it rains, paper will not lose the room list.

examples.text: 我要看预订本子，可是找不到我的眼镜了！
examples.trans: I need to read the booking ledger, yet I cannot find my glasses!

meanings.note: Pinyin: gè. Most common Mandarin measure word (量词), placed between a number/demonstrative and a noun (一个人, 这个).

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 刚烤好的面包卷！趁热拿一个吧。
examples.trans: Freshly baked bread rolls! Take one while it is hot.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiǔ. Cardinal number 9.

examples.text: 晚上九点？你站这儿，我们一起去开门。
examples.trans: Nine in the evening? Stay right here; let us go open the gate together.

examples.text: 九分钟！牛奶、鸡蛋和苹果都买来了！
examples.trans: Nine minutes! The milk, eggs, and apples are all here!

meanings.note: Pinyin: shū. Measure word (量词): 本 (běn), e.g. 一本书 ('a book').

examples.text: 书桌上放着两本安静的旧书。
examples.trans: Two old books sit on the desk.

examples.text: 她喜欢坐在院子里看书。
examples.trans: She likes sitting in the courtyard reading a book.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shū jià. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个书架 ('a bookcase').

examples.text: 看这个箭头——指着走廊里的书架！
examples.trans: Look at this arrow—it points at the bookcase in the hallway!

examples.text: 那个大书架靠着那面墙，已经二十年了！
examples.trans: That big bookcase has stood against that wall for twenty years!

meanings.note: Pinyin: le. After a verb, marks completion; at the end of a sentence, signals a change of situation.

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

meanings.note: Pinyin: èr. Used in counting, ordinals (第二), room numbers, and multi-digit numbers (二十); use 两 before measure words.

examples.text: 是的，宋老师，二楼四号房！坐火车累吗？
examples.trans: Yes, Teacher Song, room four on the second floor! Was the train ride tiring?

examples.text: 二十五年前我在附近教钢琴，不过记忆淡了。
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago I taught piano nearby, though memories fade.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shén me. Asks 'what?' on its own (什么？) or modifies a noun (什么茶 'what kind of tea').

examples.text: 太好了。请告诉我需要知道什么。
examples.trans: Great. Please tell me what I need to know.

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

meanings.note: Pinyin: huì. Expresses either an acquired skill (会弹钢琴) or likelihood in the future (会下雨).

examples.text: 下雨的时候，纸不会弄丢房间名单。
examples.trans: When it rains, paper will not lose the room list.

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiān. Placed before the verb to sequence actions: 先…再… ('first…, then…').

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiě. Used for writing characters, notes, letters, or reviews.

examples.text: 到星期五？没写名字，也没签名！
examples.trans: Until Friday? No name written, and no signature either!

examples.text: 只剩三十五分钟了！他肯定会写一星差评！
examples.trans: Only thirty-five minutes left! He will surely write a one-star bad review!

meanings.note: Pinyin: shí. Cardinal number 10; building block for 11–99.

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

examples.text: 给您四号钥匙。早餐从七点半到十点。
examples.trans: Here is key number four for you. Breakfast is from seven thirty to ten.

meanings.en: mouth; doorway; measure word for sips/breaths
meanings.note: Pinyin: kǒu. Counts mouthfuls of food/tea, breaths of air (一口气), or family members.

examples.text: 大门口正好来了一辆出租车。
examples.trans: A taxi has just pulled up right at the front gate.

examples.text: 宋老师早上好！看昨晚大门口送来了什么。
examples.trans: Good morning, Teacher Song! Look what arrived at our front gate last night.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hào. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个号码 ('a number').

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房今天到。
examples.trans: Right, eight guest rooms, eight brass keys. Room four arrives today.

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hòu mian. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 最后面 ('the very back').

examples.text: 老板，看一下桌子后面的镜子。
examples.trans: Boss, take a look in the mirror behind the desk.

examples.text: 志豪先生！您一直站在后面吗？！
examples.trans: Mr Zhihao! Were you standing right there behind us?!

meanings.note: Pinyin: ba. At the end of a sentence, softens commands into friendly suggestions ('let's…') or asks for confirmation.

examples.text: 你好！你就是小晴吧？我是厨房的小美。
examples.trans: Hello! You must be Qing, right? I am Mei from the kitchen.

examples.text: 刚烤好的面包卷！趁热拿一个吧。
examples.trans: Freshly baked bread rolls! Take one while it is hot.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ne. After a noun, asks 'what about X?' (你呢？); at the end of a statement, highlights an ongoing situation.

examples.text: 等一下，咖啡厅的小美正朝我招手呢！
examples.trans: Wait a moment—Mei in the café is waving toward me right now!

examples.text: 来成都的第一个晚上，怎么能难过呢！
examples.trans: On your very first evening in Chengdu, how could you sit around sad!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhōu. Surname of Manager Zhou (周经理); as a noun/classifier, means 'week'.

examples.text: 周经理早！桌子很干净，钥匙也准备好了。
examples.trans: Morning, Manager Zhou! The desk is clean, and the keys are ready too.

examples.text: 放心吧，周经理。房间干净，毛巾也是新的。
examples.trans: Relax, Manager Zhou. The room is clean, and the towels are fresh.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kā fēi. Measure word (量词): 杯 (bēi), e.g. 一杯咖啡 ('a cup of coffee').

examples.text: 因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！
examples.trans: Because good coffee and warm bread make people happy!

examples.text: 我还没喝早咖啡呢，千万别说急事！
examples.trans: I have not had my morning coffee yet; please do not say emergency!

related.gloss: a cup of coffee (measure word 杯)

meanings.note: Pinyin: a. Expresses sudden realization at the start of a line, or softens warmth at the end.

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 你好，小美，很高兴认识你！好香啊！
examples.trans: Hello, Mei, nice to meet you! Something smells wonderful!

meanings.note: Pinyin: hē. Used for drinking tea, coffee, water, juice, AND soup in Mandarin (喝汤).

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

examples.text: 我还没喝早咖啡呢，千万别说急事！
examples.trans: I have not had my morning coffee yet; please do not say emergency!

meanings.note: Pinyin: huí tóu. Appears in the friendly farewell 回头见！ ('See you soon!').

examples.text: 我先去送热茶，我们回头聊！
examples.trans: Let me deliver this hot tea first—we will talk soon!

examples.text: 今天辛苦了，回头见！
examples.trans: Great work today—see you soon!

meanings.note: Pinyin: tú. Measure word (量词): 张 (zhāng), e.g. 一张图 ('a plan').

examples.text: 里面有……一把大门钥匙、一张蓝色的图，还有明信片。
examples.trans: Inside there's... one big door key, a blue plan, and postcards.

examples.text: 老陈在纸上画了一张去五金店的图。
examples.trans: Chen drew a map to the hardware shop on a piece of paper.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zài. As main verb/preposition, gives location (在院子里); before another verb, marks ongoing action ('be doing').

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dì xià shì. Measure word (量词): 间 (jiān), e.g. 一间地下室 ('a cellar').

examples.text: 谢谢您这么体谅！老陈马上去地下室检查。
examples.trans: Thank you for being so understanding! Chen will check the basement right away.

examples.text: 折叠椅整齐地收在干燥的地下室里。
examples.trans: The folding chairs are stored neatly in the dry cellar.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huài. Describes a broken pipe, lock, or appliance (坏了 'broke down').

examples.text: 送牛奶的车在城外坏了。你们看冰箱！
examples.trans: The milk delivery van broke down outside town. Look at the fridge!

examples.text: 坏消息。老热水器上的铜压力阀门裂了。
examples.trans: Bad news. The brass pressure valve on the old water heater cracked.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qiáng. Measure word (量词): 堵 (dǔ), e.g. 一堵墙 ('a wall').

examples.text: 拐弯小心点，别碰到墙！
examples.trans: Careful on the turn—do not bump the wall!

examples.text: 当然记得！每到星期五弹错一个音，他就对着墙皱眉头。
examples.trans: Of course I remember! Every Friday when he missed a note, he frowned at the wall.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dà. Everyday adjective for size, age, and strong wind or rain.

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 两双棕色大男鞋，还有灰色毛衣。
examples.trans: Two pairs of big brown men's shoes, plus grey sweaters.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎo. Everyday adjective for small size; also prefixes younger colleagues' names warmly (小晴, 小美).

examples.text: 早上好，小姑娘。我订了房间，我姓宋。
examples.trans: Good morning, young lady. I booked a room; my surname is Song.

examples.text: 白纸包着什么？一个木头小火车！
examples.trans: What is wrapped in white paper? A little wooden train!

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǐ jīng. Often pairs with sentence-final 了 (已经到了 'has already arrived').

examples.text: 没错！你已经很习惯这儿了。
examples.trans: Exactly! You already fit right in here.

examples.text: 还好烤箱里的面团已经准备好了。
examples.trans: Thankfully the bread dough in the oven is already ready.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nián. Time classifier taking no 个 directly after numbers (六年 'six years', 今年 'this year').

examples.text: 二十五年前我在附近教钢琴，不过记忆淡了。
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago I taught piano nearby, though memories fade.

examples.text: 老橡木，八十年了，一滴水都不漏。
examples.trans: Old oak, eighty years old—not a single drop leaks.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kāi. Versatile verb for opening doors, starting business, turning on taps/lights, or water boiling.

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 当然不能偷看……咦，自己翻开在中间那页了！
examples.trans: Of course we must not peek... oh, it fell open to the middle page by itself!

张.gloss: measure word for flat surfaces and paper

meanings.en: measure word for flat surfaces and paper
meanings.note: Pinyin: zhāng. Counts tables, beds, paper sheets, tickets, receipts, and luggage tags (一张桌子, 一张纸).

examples.text: 不在，只有我的笔和三张旧收据！
examples.trans: Not there—only my pen and three old receipts!

examples.text: 旁边的把手上系着一张小纸牌。
examples.trans: There is a small paper card tied on the side handle.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hěn. Links a subject to a simple predicate adjective without needing 是 (今天很冷 'It is cold today').

examples.text: 你好，小美，很高兴认识你！好香啊！
examples.trans: Hello, Mei, nice to meet you! Something smells wonderful!

examples.text: 没错！你已经很习惯这儿了。
examples.trans: Exactly! You already fit right in here.

meanings.note: Pinyin: de. Read de after a verb to introduce how it goes (走得快 'walk fast'); read děi before a verb to mean 'must'.

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xīn. Measure word (量词): 颗 (kē), e.g. 一颗心 ('a heart').

examples.text: 我心跳得好快！小晴你去说，你声音稳重诚实！
examples.trans: My heart is pounding! Qing, you explain it—you sound calm and honest!

examples.text: 志鹏不会走的。他总是嘴硬五秒钟，心马上就软了。
examples.trans: Zhipeng will not leave. He always talked tough for five seconds, then softened right away.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kuài. As an adjective/adverb, 'fast/quickly'; in 快…了, 'about to'.

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 小晴，快看里面！这不是我的箱子！
examples.trans: Qing, look inside quickly! This is not my case!

meanings.note: Pinyin: nín. Respectful singular 'you' used with elders, teachers, and guests (您好！).

examples.text: 在您的外套口袋里吗？
examples.trans: Are they in your coat pocket?

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

meanings.note: Pinyin: màn màn. Polite host phrase: 慢慢吃 ('take your time eating'), 慢慢走 ('walk safely').

examples.text: 凉？啊——对！老街水管早上需要慢慢热身！
examples.trans: Cool? Ah—yes! Old-street water pipes need a gentle morning warm-up!

examples.text: 把蓝色转轮慢慢往左拧开——别太快。
examples.trans: Turn the blue wheel open slowly to the left—not too fast.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǒ. First-person singular pronoun; add 的 for 'my' (我的) and 们 for 'we/us' (我们).

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǒ men. First-person plural pronoun; add 的 for 'our' (我们的).

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 谢谢！我们平时都直接叫名字吗？
examples.trans: Thank you! Do we usually just call each other by name here?

meanings.note: Pinyin: fáng. Measure word (量词): 间 (jiān), e.g. 一间房 ('a room').

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房今天到。
examples.trans: Right, eight guest rooms, eight brass keys. Room four arrives today.

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

扇.gloss: measure word for doors and windows

meanings.en: measure word for doors and windows
meanings.note: Pinyin: shàn. Counts hinged or sliding doors and windows (一扇门 'a door', 一扇窗户 'a window').

examples.text: 上楼梯，平台往左拐，最上面最后一扇门。
examples.trans: Up the stairs, turn left at the landing, last door at the very top.

examples.text: 再往左拐进小广场，找一扇蓝木门。
examples.trans: Then turn left into the small square and look for a blue wooden door.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dǎ kāi. Result compound for opening suitcases, envelopes, boxes, or laptops.

examples.text: 我的行李箱！快打开上面口袋……对，红丝带！
examples.trans: My suitcase! Let me open the top pocket... yes, the red ribbon!

examples.text: 先生？他说：请别打开白纸包，我星期五中午来。
examples.trans: Sir? He says: Please do not open the white paper parcel; I will come Friday at noon.

meanings.en: measure word for handled objects; disposal marker
meanings.note: Pinyin: bǎ. Counts items with handles or backs (一把钥匙, 一把椅子); as a preposition, fronts a definite object before an action verb.

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房今天到。
examples.trans: Right, eight guest rooms, eight brass keys. Room four arrives today.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǐ. Used for pointing toward a sign, map, or clue (指着).

examples.text: 谁也没走开！志豪正指着那两把椅子呢！
examples.trans: Neither of them walked away! Hao is pointing at those two chairs right now!

examples.text: 周经理，快看志豪先生用铅笔指的地方！
examples.trans: Manager Zhou, look where Mr Zhihao is pointing with his pencil!

meanings.note: Pinyin: bān. Used for moving furniture, boxes, or moving house.

examples.text: 四个纸箱五分钟就能搬走。现在就上去看！
examples.trans: We can move four boxes in five minutes. Let's go up and look right now!

examples.text: 请帮我把这张桌子搬到院子里。
examples.trans: Please help me move this table out to the courtyard.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fàng xīn. Literally 'set one's heart down' (请放心 'rest assured!').

examples.text: 放心吧，周经理。房间干净，毛巾也是新的。
examples.trans: Relax, Manager Zhou. The room is clean, and the towels are fresh.

examples.text: 放心吧，老陈，我们替你保密！
examples.trans: Rest assured, Chen—we will keep your secret!

related.gloss: handle with care (lift gently, set down gently)

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiù. Describes old houses, pipes, or letters—never a person's age (use 老 for people).

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

examples.text: 不在，只有我的笔和三张旧收据！
examples.trans: Not there—only my pen and three old receipts!

meanings.note: Pinyin: míng xìn piàn. Measure word (量词): 张 (zhāng), e.g. 一张明信片 ('a postcard').

examples.text: 从那个星期天起我们再也没说话。上周我给他寄了一张明信片。
examples.trans: Since that Sunday we have not spoken again. Last week I mailed him a postcard.

examples.text: 看，已经十二点零四分了。也许他把明信片扔进垃圾桶了。
examples.trans: Look, it is twelve-oh-four already. Maybe he tossed the postcard into the bin.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zuó tiān. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 昨天一天 ('yesterday').

examples.text: 完了！昨天我没戴眼镜，在平板上接了电话预订！
examples.trans: Disaster! Yesterday without my glasses I took a phone booking on the tablet!

examples.text: 是的，我叫志豪。昨天打电话订了七号房。
examples.trans: Yes, my name is Zhihao. Yesterday I booked room seven by phone.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǎn shang. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个晚上 ('an evening').

examples.text: 来成都的第一个晚上，怎么能难过呢！
examples.trans: On your very first evening in Chengdu, how could you sit around sad!

examples.text: 晚上九点？你站这儿，我们一起去开门。
examples.trans: Nine in the evening? Stay right here; let us go open the gate together.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǒu. Expresses both possession ('I have') and existence ('there is'); ALWAYS negated with 没 (没有), never 不.

examples.text: 有道理！这些是钥匙吗？
examples.trans: Fair enough! Are these the keys?

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

meanings.note: Pinyin: mù tou. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块木头 ('a piece of wood').

examples.text: 白纸包着什么？一个木头小火车！
examples.trans: What is wrapped in white paper? A little wooden train!

examples.text: 怪不得这么重，全是木头和皮鞋！
examples.trans: No wonder it was so heavy—all wood and leather shoes!

related.gloss: a piece of wood (measure word 块)

meanings.note: Pinyin: lóu. Measure word (量词): 栋 (dòng), e.g. 一栋楼 ('a building').

examples.text: 是的，宋老师，二楼四号房！坐火车累吗？
examples.trans: Yes, Teacher Song, room four on the second floor! Was the train ride tiring?

examples.text: 等等——三楼楼梯上面是什么地方？
examples.trans: Wait—what is above the stairs on the third floor?

meanings.note: Pinyin: rán hòu. Connects sequential events across clauses.

examples.text: 过桥，右边经过绿药店。然后呢？
examples.trans: Cross the bridge, green pharmacy on the right. And after that?

examples.text: 先把门把手往上提，然后再往里推。
examples.trans: Lift the door handle upward first, and then push inward.

meanings.note: Pinyin: de. Links modifiers or owners to nouns (我的书 'my book', 安静的院子 'quiet courtyard').

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

meanings.note: Pinyin: gài zi. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个木头盖子 ('a wooden lid').

examples.text: 开了！老陈，快打开木头盖子！
examples.trans: It's open! Chen, quick, lift the wooden lid!

examples.text: 盖子要小心一点——它已经关了几十年了。
examples.trans: Careful with the lid—it has been closed for decades.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kàn. Covers looking at something, reading silently, or visiting someone; add 见/到 for 'catch sight of'.

examples.text: 我要看预订本子，可是找不到我的眼镜了！
examples.trans: I need to read the booking ledger, yet I cannot find my glasses!

examples.text: 老板，看一下桌子后面的镜子。
examples.trans: Boss, take a look in the mirror behind the desk.

meanings.en: take a look; have a quick look
meanings.note: Pinyin: kàn kan. Friendly reduplicated form of 看.

examples.text: 快拿到楼下灯光下面看看吧！
examples.trans: Let's bring it downstairs under the light and take a look!

examples.text: 哎呀，怎么拿错了！我戴眼镜看看行李牌。
examples.trans: Dear me, what a mix-up! Let me put on my glasses and check the luggage tag.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǎn jìng. Measure word (量词): 副 (fù), e.g. 一副眼镜 ('a pair of glasses').

examples.text: 我要看预订本子，可是找不到我的眼镜了！
examples.trans: I need to read the booking ledger, yet I cannot find my glasses!

examples.text: 我的眼镜怎么会在……哎呀！在我头上！
examples.trans: Why would my glasses be in... oh dear! They are on my head!

related.gloss: a pair of glasses (measure word 副)

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhe. Placed right after a verb to show a state or posture continues (门开着 'the door stands open').

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

examples.text: 白纸包着什么？一个木头小火车！
examples.trans: What is wrapped in white paper? A little wooden train!

meanings.note: Pinyin: dì. Placed before any number to turn it into an ordinal (第一 'first', 第二天 'the second day').

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

meanings.note: Pinyin: děng deng. Urgent or casual reduplication of 等 ('wait!').

examples.text: 等等，深蓝色的，跟您的一样啊！
examples.trans: Wait—it is dark blue, the same as yours!

examples.text: 等等，这条街就在附近，走过去只要五分钟！
examples.trans: Wait—that street is right nearby, only five minutes on foot!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiàn tóu. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个箭头 ('an arrow').

examples.text: 看这个箭头——指着走廊里的书架！
examples.trans: Look at this arrow—it points at the bookcase in the hallway!

examples.text: 跟着地上的箭头走，就能找到前台。
examples.trans: Follow the arrows on the floor and you will find the front desk.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǐ. Measure word (量词): 张 (zhāng), e.g. 一张纸 ('a sheet of paper').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

related.gloss: a sheet of paper (measure word 张)

meanings.note: Pinyin: jīng lǐ. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位经理 ('a manager').

examples.text: 周经理早！桌子很干净，钥匙也准备好了。
examples.trans: Morning, Manager Zhou! The desk is clean, and the keys are ready too.

examples.text: 放心吧，周经理。房间干净，毛巾也是新的。
examples.trans: Relax, Manager Zhou. The room is clean, and the towels are fresh.

meanings.note: Pinyin: láo bǎn. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位老板 ('a boss / shop owner').

examples.text: 老板，看一下桌子后面的镜子。
examples.trans: Boss, take a look in the mirror behind the desk.

examples.text: 老板正在开锁呢！别挂电话，等一秒。
examples.trans: The owner is unlocking it right now! Stay on the phone, wait one second.

related.gloss: a boss / shop owner (measure word 位)

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǎo chén. Affectionate respectful name for Courtyard Inn's handyman.

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

examples.text: 谢谢老陈。里面的木头小火车看着很珍贵。
examples.trans: Thank you, Chen. The little wooden train inside looked very precious.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huā yuán. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个小花园 ('a small garden').

examples.text: 啊！看这儿：一楼，九号房，花园阳光房！
examples.trans: Aha! Look here: ground floor, Room Nine, garden sunroom!

examples.text: 等等，我们一楼有一个花园阳光房？
examples.trans: Wait, we have a garden sunroom on the ground floor?

meanings.note: Pinyin: lán. Describes blue suitcases, doors, or teacups.

examples.text: 每个蓝杯子旁边放一张餐巾和一把小勺子。
examples.trans: Beside every blue cup, put one napkin and one small spoon.

examples.text: 储藏室里有两个软枕头和一块蓝地毯！
examples.trans: In the storeroom there are two soft pillows and a blue rug!

meanings.note: Pinyin: lán sè. Measure word (量词): 种 (zhǒng), e.g. 一种蓝色 ('a shade of blue').

examples.text: 从这儿往里走。我帮您把蓝色行李箱提上去。
examples.trans: Walk inward from here. I will carry the blue suitcase up for you.

examples.text: 等等，深蓝色的，跟您的一样啊！
examples.trans: Wait—it is dark blue, the same as yours!

related.gloss: a shade of blue (measure word 种)

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiàn. Appears in farewells (再见, 明天见) and as result complement of perception (看见, 听见).

examples.text: 晚安，小晴。明天早餐见。
examples.trans: Good night, Qing. See you at breakfast tomorrow.

examples.text: 老陈，听得见吗？我刚经过绿药店！
examples.trans: Chen, can you hear me? I just passed the green pharmacy!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zǒu láng. Measure word (量词): 条 (tiáo), e.g. 一条走廊 ('a hallway').

examples.text: 看这个箭头——指着走廊里的书架！
examples.trans: Look at this arrow—it points at the bookcase in the hallway!

examples.text: 一扇真的门，就藏在走廊里！
examples.trans: A real door, hidden right here in the hallway!

meanings.note: Pinyin: gēn. As a verb, 'follow' (跟我来 'follow me'); as a preposition, 'with' (跟你一样 'same as yours').

examples.text: 跟我当然啦！客气话留给客人吧。
examples.trans: With me, of course! Save the polite talk for the guests.

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tiào. Describes jumping or a racing heartbeat (心跳得好快).

examples.text: 谢谢你，小美。刚才吓了一跳，手都凉了！
examples.trans: Thank you, Mei. That gave me such a start just now that my hands went cold!

examples.text: 我心跳得好快！小晴你去说，你声音稳重诚实！
examples.trans: My heart is pounding! Qing, you explain it—you sound calm and honest!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhuàn. Read zhuàn for spinning wheels or quick wits (脑子转得快 'mind works fast').

examples.text: 脑子转得快，小晴。志豪每星期都读城市建筑规定。
examples.trans: Quick thinking, Qing. Hao reads city building rules every single week.

examples.text: 风一吹，纸风车就飞快地转起来。
examples.trans: When the breeze blows, the paper pinwheel spins fast.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hái. Everyday adverb meaning 'still' (还在), 'not yet' (还没), or 'even more' after 比.

examples.text: 还没有吗？请记下我们客栈的电话和地址，谢谢！
examples.trans: Not yet? Please write down our inn's phone number and address, thank you!

examples.text: 宋老师，真对不起，那边还没有消息。
examples.trans: Teacher Song, I am truly sorry; they have no news over there yet.

meanings.en: and also; in addition; still have
meanings.note: Pinyin: hái yǒu. Adds another item to a list ('plus…').

examples.text: 只有裙子、乐谱，还有我最喜欢的茶杯！
examples.trans: Only dresses, sheet music, and my favourite teacup!

examples.text: 两双棕色大男鞋，还有灰色毛衣。
examples.trans: Two pairs of big brown men's shoes, plus grey sweaters.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhè. Proximal demonstrative; pairs with a measure word before nouns (这个 'this one', 这间房 'this room').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhèr. Spoken variant of 这里 ('here').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 没错！你已经很习惯这儿了。
examples.trans: Exactly! You already fit right in here.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nà. Distal demonstrative before measure words (那个 'that one'); at clause start, means 'then / well then'.

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nà me. Opens a conclusion drawn from what was just said (那么，门在哪儿？ 'So where is the door?'); before an adjective it means 'that (much)'.

examples.text: 那么，那些旧书后面有第九扇门！
examples.trans: So behind those old books, there's a ninth door!

examples.text: 那么小美的咖啡馆和宋老师的钢琴，不会吵醒楼上的客人吧？
examples.trans: So Mei's café and Teacher Song's piano won't wake the guests upstairs?

meanings.note: Pinyin: nà xiē. Plural of 那个 ('those').

examples.text: 老陈，抱起那些纸箱，我们下楼吧！
examples.trans: Chen, pick up those cardboard boxes—down the stairs we go!

examples.text: 抬头看夜空下那些金色灯笼——真宁静啊！
examples.trans: Look up at those golden lanterns against the night sky—how peaceful!

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǐ. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 里面 ('the inside').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 在您的外套口袋里吗？
examples.trans: Are they in your coat pocket?

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǐ miàn. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 箱子里面 ('inside the suitcase').

examples.text: 我来帮您。哎呀，里面装了石头吗？
examples.trans: Let me help you. Goodness, did you pack stones inside?

examples.text: 小晴，快看里面！这不是我的箱子！
examples.trans: Qing, look inside quickly! This is not my case!

meanings.note: Pinyin: yào shi. Measure word (量词): 把 (bǎ), e.g. 一把钥匙 ('a key').

examples.text: 有道理！这些是钥匙吗？
examples.trans: Fair enough! Are these the keys?

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房今天到。
examples.trans: Right, eight guest rooms, eight brass keys. Room four arrives today.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tóng. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块铜 ('a piece of brass').

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房今天到。
examples.trans: Right, eight guest rooms, eight brass keys. Room four arrives today.

examples.text: 楼下我的工具房里有一盏铜台灯。
examples.trans: Downstairs in my workshop there is a brass desk lamp.

related.gloss: a piece of brass (measure word 块)

meanings.note: Pinyin: suǒ. Works as both verb ('lock the door' 锁门) and noun ('a lock' 一把锁).

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mén. Measure word (量词): 扇 (shàn), e.g. 一扇门 ('a door').

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 这是三楼阁楼门的小银钥匙。
examples.trans: Here is the small silver key to the third-floor attic door.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yáng guāng fáng. Measure word (量词): 间 (jiān), e.g. 一间阳光房 ('a sunroom').

examples.text: 啊！看这儿：一楼，九号房，花园阳光房！
examples.trans: Aha! Look here: ground floor, Room Nine, garden sunroom!

examples.text: 等等，我们一楼有一个花园阳光房？
examples.trans: Wait, we have a garden sunroom on the ground floor?

meanings.en: lean against; be next to; rely on
meanings.note: Pinyin: kào. Describes sitting by the window (靠窗) or relying on luck (全靠运气).

examples.text: 全靠运气——加上星期一早上火车上拿错的蓝色行李箱！
examples.trans: Pure luck—plus one swapped blue suitcase on Monday morning's train!

examples.text: 她喜欢坐在靠窗的安静位置。
examples.trans: She likes sitting in the quiet spot by the window.

meanings.note: Pinyin: miàn. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一面 ('one side').

examples.text: 这面圆镜子挂哪儿？窗户左边还是右边？
examples.trans: Where should I hang this round mirror? Left of the window or right?

examples.text: 墙上挂着一面干净的大镜子。
examples.trans: A clean large mirror hangs on the wall.

meanings.note: Pinyin: é tóu. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个额头 ('a forehead').

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

examples.text: 笔挺又干净，周经理！连眼镜都戴在鼻子上，没在额头上。
examples.trans: Crisp and spotless, Manager Zhou! Even your glasses are on your nose instead of your forehead.
